xcut_findings.title: z-report.pdf is NOT a PDF — it is a 690-byte JSON payload mis-extensioned

empirical_proof.header_bytes: First 500 bytes start with '{"data":{"z_report":{"id":1,...' — not '%PDF-' magic header.
empirical_proof.size: 690 bytes — orders of magnitude smaller than a real Z-report PDF (typical 1.2 MB per BRAIN HEAL-3 EOD PDF reference).
empirical_proof.content_match_with_04_close_json: Body is bit-identical to /tmp/foodking-wave-c-2026-05-28/z-pdf-live/04-close.json — proves the agent either curl-saved the close response under the wrong filename OR the /pdf endpoint silently returned JSON.

two_hostile_interpretations: A) TEST-TOOLING DEFECT: the live-z agent saved POST /z-reports/{id}/close response to z-report.pdf instead of separately GETting the /pdf endpoint. Cheap fix in the agent script. Does NOT impeach backend.

B) NF525 DEFECT (worse): the actual /z-reports/{id}/pdf or /z-reports/{id}.pdf endpoint is broken and returning JSON to a PDF Accept header (or the route is missing and Laravel SPA catchall returned the JSON-close response). This is the 'silent HTML masquerade' pattern documented in MEMORY (feedback_silent_html_masquerade) but applied to PDF endpoint. CAUSE-A and CAUSE-B are indistinguishable without seeing the agent's curl/wget command — recommend running 'curl -H "Accept: application/pdf" -o /tmp/probe.pdf .../z-reports/1/pdf' and checking Content-Type + magic header.
xcut_findings.recommendation: BLOCK Z-PDF claim until A vs B disambiguated. If B: this is a NF525 owner-facing defect (PDF Z-report is the legal daily archive — 6-year retention obligation, BRAIN section 8). Issue a P0 backend ticket. If A: harden the agent script + retry — but ALSO add a sentinel test that GETs the PDF endpoint and asserts magic header '%PDF-'.
